entries.text: Oh, Anna, there you are! I am so glad we joined the Great City Bird Count! Aren't you?
entries.translation: 哦，安娜，你在这儿啊！我很高兴我们参加了大城市观鸟统计！你不高兴吗？

entries.text: No. Today has been a bust ... a flop ... a bummer!
entries.translation: 不。今天真是白忙一场……失败……太扫兴了！

entries.text: I'm sensing a little disappointment.
entries.translation: 我感觉到你有点失望。

entries.text: My official bird-watching form is almost full!
entries.translation: 我的官方观鸟记录表都快填满了！

entries.text: I've only seen pigeons ... lots and lots of pigeons! But I did write down some other valuable information.
entries.translation: 我只看到了鸽子……好多好多鸽子！不过我确实记下了别的一些有价值的信息。

entries.text: I found 10 ice cream trucks in this five-block area. Their music seems to follow me everywhere.
entries.translation: 我在这五个街区里发现了十辆冰淇淋车。它们的音乐好像到处跟着我。

entries.text: We're supposed to be counting birds, not ice cream trucks. This is important scientific work!
entries.translation: 我们应该数的是鸟，不是冰淇淋车。这是重要的科学工作！

entries.text: Well, when you want ice cream, my data will be pretty important.
entries.translation: 嗯，等你想吃冰淇淋时，我的数据就会很重要。

entries.text: Anna, birds are everywhere! I'm sure you'll find something. Use your imagination! But make sure that you put it on the official form.
entries.translation: 安娜，鸟到处都是！我相信你会发现什么。发挥想象力！但一定要把它记在官方表格上。

entries.text: That man is in the way. I can't see the price. I wonder what flavor he's getting.
entries.translation: 那个人挡住了。我看不见价格。我想知道他买的是什么口味。

entries.text: Strawberry? He doesn't seem like a strawberry kind of guy.
entries.translation: 草莓？他看起来不像是喜欢草莓的那种人。

entries.text: In fact, he doesn't seem like an ice cream truck kind of guy. That suit looks expensive.
entries.translation: 事实上，他看起来不像会买冰淇淋车冰淇淋的人。那套西装看起来很贵。

entries.text: Maybe he's a spy! You know what that means: The ice cream truck driver is a spy, too!
entries.translation: 也许他是间谍！你知道这意味着什么：冰淇淋车司机也是间谍！

entries.text: Genius! It's a perfect disguise.
entries.translation: 天才！这是完美的伪装。

entries.text: I was right! He is a spy! And, he just dropped off top-secret information! I ought to do something. Something needs to be done! I need to do something.
entries.translation: 我说对了！他是间谍！而且他刚交接了绝密信息！我应该做点什么。必须有人采取行动！我得做点什么。

entries.text: I did it! I took the spy's briefcase!
entries.translation: 我做到了！我拿走了间谍的公文包！

entries.text: What's that?! The ice cream truck -- it's following me! It wants the case back! I have to hide.
entries.translation: 那是什么？！冰淇淋车——它在跟着我！它想拿回箱子！我必须躲起来。

entries.text: This is my life now -- running, scared, alone.
entries.translation: 这就是我现在的生活——奔跑、害怕、孤身一人。

entries.text: Poems? You're a poet?
entries.translation: 诗？你是诗人？

entries.text: So, you're not a spy?
entries.translation: 所以，你不是间谍？
